title: POL-534: policy for the Payroll Gateway
body:
## Scope

This policy applies to every user of the Payroll Gateway and is in draft. The policy owner is Clara
Dubois (Product Support); yearly audits against the controls listed here are run by Silverline Data.

## Requirements

Every person in scope must meet these requirements, reviewed on 15 November 2025:
- Review access lists for every production system each quarter
- Encrypt laptops and removable media with the standard tooling
- Obtain written sign-off before granting vendor access

## Status

For the record, POL-534 is in draft. Version issued 9 August 2025 by Elena Vasquez; exceptions on
file: 11, all expiring at the yearly audit.
